Join me and my co-host Jerusalem Demsas for the very first live edition of our podcast!

We'll be on stage Wednesday, December 9, at Miracle Theatre in Washington, D.C. -- and we're offering a discount on tickets for Slow Boring subscribers.

Below, paid subscribers can find a code for ~40% off. If you're not a paid subscriber, [upgrade today](https://substack.com/redirect/3d566459-e4b0-471f-9caf-bf93289b6685) for access to the code (plus you'll get to read all the articles!).

[Buy Tickets](https://substack.com/redirect/c4e91fa6-96cd-4a5e-9f34-ff40685ae242)

If you're not a regular listener to the pod and would like to check out the podcast before the live show, you can find us on [YouTube](https://substack.com/redirect/6630a475-0e1a-4164-8917-88621d17f7c7) or subscribe to hear more: [Apple Podcasts](https://substack.com/redirect/d89d849b-4f8f-4c6d-a11c-4023163e0a87) | [Spotify](https://substack.com/redirect/fc416630-44c6-4a41-802b-f29267879392) | [YouTube](https://substack.com/redirect/6630a475-0e1a-4164-8917-88621d17f7c7) | [Overcast](https://substack.com/redirect/9f9eb335-8e6a-479e-8db0-c43cf43aac5d) | [Pocket Casts...](https://substack.com/redirect/7d156bb3-92d4-43f3-b348-2aac2a37015d)
